cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: What Really Happened?
cards.instruction: Find the truth by comparing details, repeating questions, and testing which parts of the story remain consistent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll finish your lost-bag claim. At four, were you on the bus or buying coffee? You've said both.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Coffee. Can we finish the form?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll do the writing. Just tell me whether the bag was beside you when you paid.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. The driver waited while I ran in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll note the waiting bus. Go over getting back on: did the bag come out with you?

relationship.evidence: B2 wants completion and B4 supplies useful detail when A3 narrows the burden.

heightening.evidence: B4 explains the waiting driver, causing A5 to move the custody test to reboarding.
